violations.agent_message: जी, क्या आप मुझे सुन पा रही हैं?
violations.violation_detail: The agent used a silence handling phrase ("जी, क्या आप मुझे सुन पा रही हैं?") in Turn 60 when the customer had already spoken ("Hello hello" in Turn 59), which is a violation of the silence protocol.

violations.agent_message: मैं आपकी स्थिति समझता हूँ. हमारे रिकॉर्ड्स के अनुसार, आपका कुल बकाया पचास हज़ार रुपये है. हालांकि, हम सभी शुल्क हटाकर आपका लोन शून्य रुपये में बंद कर सकते हैं.
violations.violation_detail: The agent failed to dig deeper into the borrower's financial situation after she stated she was a "simple housewife" and could not pay (Turn 53, 89). Instead of asking follow-up questions about her income or support, the agent immediately re-pitched the zero-rupee offer (Turn 54, 90). Also, when the customer offered 200 rupees (Turn 65, 73), the agent dismissed it by repeating the zero-rupee offer (Turn 66, 74) instead of probing the reason for the 200 rupees or exploring other payment options.

violations.agent_message: मैं समझ गया हूँ कि आप मृत्यु प्रमाण पत्र भेजना चाहती हैं. आप इसे support@demolender.com पर ईमेल कर सकती हैं. हालांकि, हमारे रिकॉर्ड्स के अनुसार, यह लोन अभी भी बकाया है, और शून्य रुपये का ऑफर इसे बंद करने का सबसे अच्छा तरीका है.
violations.violation_detail: The agent engaged in a circular exchange from Turn 54 onwards, repeatedly pitching the zero-rupee offer and asking for documents, while the customer repeatedly claimed the loan was paid and asked for company payment details. This went on for many turns without significant progress.

The agent failed to adapt its approach to the borrower's stated inability to email documents (Turn 103, 105) and continued to insist on email as the only method, only offering to ask for help from family/friends instead of exploring alternative methods the company could provide.

Despite the borrower repeatedly claiming the loan was fully paid (e.g., Turn 19, 43, 47, 53, 77, 83, 85), the agent did not apologize and end the call, but instead continued to re-pitch the zero-rupee offer.

violations.agent_message: मैं आपकी स्थिति समझता हूँ. हमारे रिकॉर्ड्स के अनुसार, आपका कुल बकाया पचास हज़ार रुपये है. हालांकि, हम सभी शुल्क हटाकर आपका लोन शून्य रुपये में बंद कर सकते हैं.

The agent did not fully explore the customer's situation or offer concrete solutions for the document issue, leading to a premature end to the active negotiation/resolution attempt.
